title: Cuprous thiocyanate as an inorganic hole transport material for carbon-based flexible perovskite solar cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1786-1796
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01222D, Paper
Samyuktha Noola, Gyanendra Shankar, Francesca De Rossi, Emanuele Calabrò, Matteo Bonomo, Claudia Barolo, Francesca Brunetti
Optimising CuSCN as a hole transport layer enhances the power conversion efficiency of flexible carbon-based PSCs, combining excellent hole transport properties and cost effectiveness.
